name: MOEA GCIS Company Basic Data (by 統一編號)
note: Open JSON REST API. Reliable access path is $filter=Business_Accounting_NO eq <8-digit 統一編號>. Encode spaces (%20). The Company_Name `like` filter is finicky. Dates are ROC/Minguo (YYYMMDD). Responsible_Name is personal data — redact.

name: TWSE Listed Company Basic Info
note: Open JSON array of all listed (main board) companies (~1,089). Join to GCIS on 營利事業統一編號. Setup/listing dates Gregorian. Chairman/GM/spokesperson are personal data — redact.

name: TPEx OTC Company Basic Info
note: Open JSON array of all OTC (櫃買) companies (~890). Join to GCIS on UnifiedBusinessNo. Chairman/GeneralManager are personal data — redact.
